obligations.constructed_input: The exact candidate quaternion algebra, faithful real representation, original specified principal-order coordinates and existing period quotient are consumed unchanged. The five new sources identify the same order image with a computed real-basis integer span and construct its actual Riemann form. No replacement standard lattice, elliptic j-family or unrelated Jacobian is used.
